sentences.text: Mucopolysaccharidosis type 3C and retinitis pigmentosa are both linked to the gene HGSNAT in curated databases [e_daa6e78738b9] [e_3af42a3b13cf].
Constellate computed that they share this causal gene, with confidence 0.95, the lowest of the two gene links [e_c4eefef8fc23].
Retinitis pigmentosa is also linked to the genes ABCA4 and AGBL5 by curated evidence [e_921a2325bcdf] [e_5d159ce2f45e].
It is linked to the gene CLN3 only by inference from one subtype, with confidence 0.45, and this may not hold for every form [e_2b39f1206016].
For type 3C, a staining change in cells and a dense skull cap are listed, both with a low confidence of 0.5 [e_07dc1fbfc1f3] [e_a9aea3612fad].
These edges do not explain how one gene can lead to both a whole-body storage disease and an eye disease [e_c4eefef8fc23].
They also show no studies, funding or patient groups for either disease [e_daa6e78738b9].
